portals.name: Gujarat Revenue Department online services
portals.observation: First-party page explicitly links Online Viewing of Record of Right for Rural Area (AnyRoR), Online Viewing of Property Cards (e-Milkat), and IORA revenue applications, including survey-boundary/part measurement and property-card-copy procedures. It is a statewide service/custodian reference, not proof of an open Nadiad parcel API.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Gujarat Revenue Department services are statewide land-record/property-card services; NAKSHA is a national urban parcel-mapping programme.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official service pages, current NAKSHA app shell/configuration, and bounded anonymous route checks only. Nadiad parcel feature coverage, schema, native IDs, CRS, and citywide completeness were not verified.

technicalBlocker: The official Gujarat pages expose land-record/property-card workflows, while the current NAKSHA public shell exposes route names but the inferred anonymous public-host API calls returned 404. No safe anonymous parcel feature response with native identity and geometry was available.
remainingUncertainty: Gujarat portals may require a browser session, district/taluka/village or survey-number inputs, or a separate service host. A zero exact-point hit, map extent miss, or absent anonymous response is not treated as citywide absence.
nextStep: Hold runtime integration. A later researcher may inspect a documented public Gujarat/NAKSHA feature endpoint or a user-facing parcel selection flow, confirming CRS, native identity, and safe fields before retaining geometry.
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement point; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
